facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 100 W SCHARBAUER DR, MIDLAND, TX, 79705

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: This standard was found to be out of compliance. The caregiver grabbed a child's arm tight while redirecting the child and left a bruise with fingernail marks on the child's arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 7 month old child was asleep in the crib with a blanket. This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A mob bucket of water was left untended in the hallway between four 2-year old and 3-year-old  classrooms. This was corrected at inspection when a staff removed the bucket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: This standard was found to be out of compliance. It was found there are several child injuries parents were not informed of at pick up or end of day because caregivers were unaware of the injuries or did not know how the injuries happened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was found to be out of compliance when a caregiver threw a stuffed toy at a child to stop the child from fussing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a staff picked up a child refusing to walk and forced the child out of the room dragging his feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. The preponderance determined that a caregiver ripped the children's worksheets if they were not completed correctly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: Not all probation conditions were met regarding conditions pertaning to caregiver observations. There were some blank areas not filled on observation forms (comments, suggestions). Two observations of two different employes had same date of 8/29/23 and same time frame T1B  8:18 am - 8:50 am and T2B 8:20 - 8:50 AM  time.  One observation did not have a caregiver name. Some of the observations have the name of a director assistant and not the director's name, conducting the observations. There have not been any monthly conferences conducted with observed caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash her hands after diapering a child and proceeded to feed the child. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was reminded to wash hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Nine infants not yet on table food did not have current feeding instructions. They were last updated February and March 2023. Two expired on April 1st.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a child was left out on the playground alone for one - two minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a caregiver tapped a child on the head with the child's shoes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a caregiver left a child in the classroom alone for approximately 15 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a caregiver failed to account for all children during transition.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A caregiver in the indoor playroom with 15 children allowed a child to go to the bathroom in the adjoined lobby by themselves while caregiver stood at the door between indoor playground and lobby. There was no other caregiver in the play room or the lobby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance when a caregiver lost control of a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated and was found to be out of compliance. A caregiver left the entire classroom of children unsupervised for more than two minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Contact EMS After Ensuring Supervision of Group: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. The staff did not call EMS immediately when a child lost consciousness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Contact EMS After Ensuring Supervision of Group (26 TAC §746.3607(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three staff of 15 evaluated had online CPR certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. It was found that a caregiver yelled at the children in a harsh manner while redirecting the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: This standard was evaluated and was found to be out of compliance. It was found that a caregiver hit children with her hand to redirect their behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A 14 year old without an initial background check was working as a volunteer at the operation with direct access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. A caregiver grabbed a child roughly by the arm to remove the child from an area, while redirecting the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: An outlet low to the floor in the cafeteria was uncovered. Children were sitting next to the outlet. This standard was corrected at inspection when the staff covered the outlet immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. A caregiver left her classroom of ten children unsupervised for three seconds while she went to the next door classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: This standard was evaluated and found to be out of compliance. The operation did not share the incident/illness report with the child's parent within 48 hours from the date of the incident. The child was injured on 3/31/22 and the parent received an incident report on 4/6/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: This standard was evaluated and was found to be out of compliance. The operation did not report, to Child Care Regulation, a child injury requiring medical attention, within 48 hours of the incident date. The injury and medical attention occurred on Thursday 3/31/22 and was not reported to CCR until Wednesday 4/6/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection: The building gas inspection report was not available for review at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)
